title: Read-aloud segment
description: Derived, never persisted as a file: segments are recomputed from chapter text on demand. Only the *id* is persisted (in reading state, as lastSegmentId), so the id must be stable for a given chapter text.

start.description: Char offset into the block text — same coordinate space as TextAnchor.

lang.description: Detected per segment; selects the TTS voice.

$comment: Word-level highlighting uses charIndex/charLength reported by the speech engine, relative to `text`; the renderer maps them to block offsets by adding `start`.
